jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
About Role:

Are you an Environmental Scientist ready to take the next step in your career? Fleming Lee Shue is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented specialist with 1–3 years of experience to help us tackle complex site assessment, remediation, and compliance projects. If you’re looking for a role where you can move beyond the basics and play a pivotal part in project strategy and regulatory success, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

Conduct environmental due diligence site assessments (Phase I and II ESAs)
Perform environmental site investigations including sampling of soil, groundwater and soil vapor following proper sampling protocols and regulatory requirements.
Conduct environmental oversight of contractors for large-scale remediation projects.
Perform Operation, Monitoring and Maintenance (OMM) on existing remedial systems including SSDS, SVE, and GWTS.
Prepare design documents for remedial systems (SSDS, SVE, GWTS etc.)
Prepare technical reports, environmental impact assessments, and documentation
Coordinate with regulatory agencies
Assist in remediation scoping, design, and planning environmental monitoring programs
Support environmental permitting and regulatory compliance activities
Ensure adherence to local, state, and federal environmental regulations
Perform other duties as requested.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Geology, or related scientific field
1–3 years of professional environmental consulting or industry experience
Knowledge of environmental regulations and compliance requirements including NYSDEC and OER regulations and guidance documents.
Experience with field sampling and data collection using environmental field equipment (PID, Flow Meter, Manometer, Water-Level Meter, CAMP equipment, etc.)
History of performing maintenance and monitoring on remedial systems including groundwater treatment systems, soil vapor extraction and sub-slab depressurization systems.
Strong technical writing and communication skills
Ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams
Possess a valid driver’s license in good standing and reliable transportation access to remote job site locations.
OSHA 10-hr or 40-hour HAZWOPER training a plus.

Compensation:

Compensation will range from $65k to $75K, and commensurate with experience.

What We Offer:

We provide employees with a benefit package that reflects our respect for your workplace contributions, professional goals, and personal priorities. The benefits program at Fleming Lee Shue includes:
Medical, Dental insurance
Vacation and Sick time
401(k) retirement plan with Employer Safe Habor contribution
Short- and Long-Term Disability
Tuition Reimbursement
Training and professional development courses

Why Fleming Lee Shue:

Working at Fleming Lee Shue means joining a highly respected environmental consulting firm that handles some of these most complex site investigations, remediation, and regulatory challenges in New York City. Employees gain hands-on experience on impactful projects while collaborating with experienced engineers, geologists and scientists in a strong learning environment. With meaningful responsibilities, field exposure, and clear opportunities for growth, Fleming Lee Shue offers a dynamic and rewarding career path in environmental consulting.

jobs.title: Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates in the behavioral and social science research sector, focusing on addressing urgent challenges in the United States and globally. It specializes in generating evidence and applying data-driven solutions to expand opportunities and improve lives. Within healthcare, the program collaborates with Medicare, Medicaid, federal and state agencies, foundations, and private organizations to advance evidence-based policy, financing, quality measurement, and value-based care, aiming to improve health outcomes, patient experiences, and affordability.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Data Analyst II supports healthcare-related projects by managing and analyzing complex healthcare data to produce high-quality, data-driven insights. This role applies quantitative methods and statistical modeling to large datasets, contributing to research that informs healthcare policy and program improvements. It plays a key part in ensuring accurate data analysis and effective communication of findings tailored to client needs.

3. Responsibilities:
• Analyze healthcare data including claims and national surveys.
• Construct, clean, and statistically model data using SAS and Python or R.
• Apply statistical methods to analyze data.
• Maintain accurate documentation and adhere to programming guidelines and quality assurance.
• Summarize and report data findings in memos, briefs, or reports.
• Collaborate professionally with peers, managers, and clients.
• Meet project timelines and deadlines.
• Manage and interpret research data using quantitative techniques.
• Contribute to research study design and methodology.
• Prepare technical documentation and reports.
• Review work products for accuracy and consistency.

4. Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field; master’s preferred.
• 3-5 years of quantitative research experience in health policy or related field.
• Minimum 3 years experience as a Programmer or Data Analyst with coding skills including merges, joins, and macros.
• Proficiency in SAS required; Python and R strongly preferred.
• Experience with large Medicare, Medicaid, MEPS, or similar claims or survey data.
• Knowledge of data management and analysis techniques.
• Strong problem-solving and advanced analytic skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under deadlines.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
• Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:
RemoteHunter is not the Employer of Record (EOR) for this role. Our purpose in this opportunity is to connect exceptional candidates with leading employers. We help job seekers worldwide discover roles that match their goals and guide them to complete their full application directly through the hiring company’s career page or ATS.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Marvel Strike Force
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates in the mobile gaming industry, focusing on developing, publishing, and live-operating diverse games that engage millions globally. It addresses the challenge of connecting players through varied interactive experiences across platforms including mobile, web, PC, and console. The program features a portfolio of popular games, including a squad-based hero collector RPG set in the Marvel Universe, and has established a significant presence in the gaming market.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Data Analyst - Marvel Strike Force is responsible for leveraging data to enhance player engagement, retention, monetization, and overall game health. This role involves generating actionable insights that influence decision-making across product, design, marketing, and operations teams. The position is vital for maintaining and improving the performance and player experience of the game through data-driven strategies.

3. Responsibilities:
• Utilize AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytics workflows while ensuring data quality, privacy, and business relevance.
• Collaborate with multiple teams to translate data into clear insights that drive player and business outcomes.
• Manage recurring business-health reporting including key performance indicators, trend analysis, and executive summaries.
• Analyze player behavior to identify risks, opportunities, and friction points within game systems.
• Design and validate analytics tracking for new features and events to ensure accurate performance measurement.

4. Requirements:
• B.Tech/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, Physics, or related quantitative fields.
• Minimum 2 years of experience in data analytics or similar quantitative roles.
• Proficiency in SQL and Python with experience handling complex queries from multiple sources.
• Experience creating reports using Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.
• Interest and judgment in using AI tools to enhance analytics workflows while safeguarding data integrity.
• Knowledge of A/B testing and experimentation, including design, metrics, and interpretation.
• Strong communication skills to convey analysis into actionable recommendations.
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced live-service environment.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, annual salary ranges from $91,300 to $140,000 USD.
• Eligibility for equity, bonuses, and comprehensive benefits including healthcare, retirement plans, pet insurance, paid holidays, and unlimited paid time off.
• Base pay varies based on knowledge, skills, and experience.

6. Benefits & Perks:
• Healthcare benefits
• Retirement benefits
• Pet insurance
• Paid holidays
• Unlimited paid time off

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

Note:
